subject: Re: Kickoff: symbolic regression — resourcing
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Tereza reproduces the expression-generating NN training (the models folder path), Yusuf owns the constraint-conditioning eval and the baseline comparisons against the empirical-distribution models, Leilani builds the service wrapper and the grammar tooling (we extend the univariate_one_constant_grammar production rules for customer feature vocabularies).

Compute — individual models are small but the June evaluation is a large matrix: beam widths x constraint settings x the three holdout tiers (M<=4, M=5, M=6), with enough sampled expressions per cell for the novelty metrics to be meaningful. We're consolidating that into our reserved slot: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation, 256 accelerators, for the week of 2026-06-15, which runs the full eval matrix plus Tereza's retraining ablations in one pass. Before that, titan best-effort suffices.

Grammar tooling is the sleeper risk — customer vocabularies blow up the production-rule set fast. Leilani is prototyping caps.

Bruno
